```card-forge
card:
  system: tor2e
  card-type: gear
data:
  # The card's name. Falls back to the file name.
  name: Hunting spear

  # The card's picture as a wikilink (`[[Langschwert.png]]`), embed or file name — on the back, large.
  image: '[[Jagdspeer.png]]'

  # Source reference — rulebook page or wikilink.
  reference: Rulebook p. 74

  # The weapon's damage — the value a hit takes off Endurance.
  damage: 4

  # Injury — a Feat Die at this or more makes a hit a Piercing Blow.
  injury: # no sample

  # Injury when wielded one-handed, for a weapon that can be either.
  injury-1h: 14

  # Injury when wielded two-handed.
  injury-2h: 16

  # Load — counts toward the total Load and so toward Fatigue.
  load: 2

  # An armour's protection in protection dice — "2d".
  protection: # no sample

  # A shield's parry modifier — +1 buckler, +2 shield, +3 great shield.
  parry-modifier: # no sample

  # The combat proficiency the weapon is wielded with — Axes, Bows, Spears, Swords; a wikilink if you like.
  combat-proficiency: '[[Spears]]'

  # The kind of gear as a line in the text — weapon, armour, shield; a wikilink if you like.
  type: # no sample

  # The minimum standard of living to own the item without further ado — Poor, Frugal, Common, Prosperous, Rich.
  minimum-standard-of-living: Frugal

  # Notes or special qualities (markdown).
  notes: May be wielded one- or two-handed, and thrown.
```
